metadata.origin_note: Country indicates a common culinary association, not necessarily a proven or exclusive place of invention. null/Global denotes generic animal-only dishes.
metadata.diet_note: diet_type is the most restrictive ingredient-based dietary group. suitable_for contains filter codes, not medical, allergen or religious certifications. Carnivore means animal-derived ingredients plus salt.
metadata.quantity_note: All quantities are approximate planning estimates for exactly one person (including oil and seasonings where listed), not individually tested recipes. Round amounts and account for package sizes when shopping. Soaking, marinating, proofing and chilling are not included in prep_minutes + cook_minutes.
metadata.effort_rule: Low / medium / high estimated effort based on difficulty, preparation and total time; not independently measured.
metadata.license: CC0-1.0 for this originally manually authored planning dataset (not for any separately imported external content).
metadata.localization_note: Display strings are localized; keys, IDs, units, codes and quantities stay identical across locales.
metadata.image_reference_note: Both locales share images under recipe_images/<id>/. images only contains verified images that were actually downloaded; an empty array indicates no image is available yet.
metadata.image_note: Illustrative recipe imagery. New images were composed programmatically based on recipe names and ingredients and are not photographs of actual dishes.
